data.name: Muhaimin
data.gender_notes: Muhaimin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who guards, defends, and protects. The name Muhaimin carries the meaning “Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhaimin usually hope their child will grow to embody protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of security, safety, and defense in the path of Allah.
data.etymology: Muhaimin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhaimin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مُحَيْمِن
in_arabic.meaning: الله عز وجل کا ایک نام، محافظ، نگہبان، حافظ
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُحَيْمِن اللہ عز وجل کے صفاتی ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے محافظ، نگہبان، اور حافظ۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے اور اس کا تعلق اللہ کی حفظ و نگہداشت کی قدرت سے ہے۔ مُحَيْمِن کا اطلاق اللہ عز وجل پر اس لیے ہوتا ہے کیونکہ وہ اپنے بندوں کی حفاظت کرتا ہے اور ان کی نگہداشت کرتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: مُحَيْمِن
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک نام، محافظ، نگہبان، حافظ
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُحَيْمِن اللہ تعالیٰ کے صفاتي ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے محافظ، نگہبان، اور حافظ۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے اور اس کا تعلق اللہ کی حفظ و نگہداشت کی قدرت سے ہے۔ مُحَيْمِن کا اطلاق اللہ تعالیٰ پر اس لیے ہوتا ہے کیونکہ وہ اپنے بندوں کی حفاظت کرتا ہے اور ان کی نگہداشت کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुहैमिन
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह का एक नाम, रक्षक, रखवाला, संरक्षक
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहैमिन अल्लाह के विशेषण नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है रक्षक, रखवाला, और संरक्षक। यह नाम कुरआन में उल्लिखित है और इसका संबंध अल्लाह की सुरक्षा और संरक्षण की शक्ति से है। मुहैमिन का प्रयोग अल्लाह के लिए किया जाता है क्योंकि वह अपने अनुयायियों की रक्षा करता है और उनकी देखभाल करता है।

in_pashto.name: محيمين
in_pashto.meaning: الله تعالی د نوم، ساتونکی، څښتن، محافظ
in_pashto.long_meaning: محيمين د الله تعالی له صفاتي نومونو څخه يو دی، چې معنی يې دي ساتونکی، څښتن، او محافظ. دا نوم په قرآن کريم کې ذکر شوی دی او د الله د حفاظت او ساتنې د قدرت سره تړاو لري. محيمين د الله تعالی لپاره کارول کيږي ځکه چې هغه خپلو بنده ګانو ته حفاظت کوي او د هغوی ساتنه کوي.

in_english.name: Muhaimin
in_english.meaning: One of Allah's names, protector, guardian, preserver
in_english.long_meaning: Muhaimin is one of the attributive names of Allah, meaning protector, guardian, and preserver. This name is mentioned in the Quran and relates to Allah's power of protection and preservation. Muhaimin is attributed to Allah because He protects and preserves His servants, ensuring their safety and well-being.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: محيمين

data.cultural_impact: The name Muhaimin, in the Islamic cultural context, is a powerful name carrying a significant meaning related to the protective nature of God and the responsibility of Muslims as His vicegerents on earth. Since the meaning is associated with being a guardian, protector, and defender, it could be an inspiration for an individual to be vigilant, brave, just, and compassionate in their daily lives. Moreover, the name could symbolize an act of care, safety, and security for communities, emphasizing the importance of unity, mutual support, and solidarity in Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Muhaimin carries deep meanings rooted in the Islamic belief of God's endless mercy, compassion, and protection. As a believer of God, the name reminds us of our role to protect the creations and people around us and to uphold the values and teachings of Islam. It serves as a reminder of God's watchfulness over us and the importance of remaining steadfast in our faith. The name Muhaimin is an invitation to focus on spiritual growth, self-reflection, and personal discipline that empower us to become genuine protectors of ourselves, our loved ones, and the broader community.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protector" symbolizes One who guards, defends, and protects.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Muhaimin serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protector.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidaya wa'l-Nihaya (The Beginning and the End) - Volume 7, page 206 The name Muhaimin carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mu'awiyah I, the Umayyad caliph, appointed 'Amr ibn al-'As as the governor of Egypt. 'Amr invited Umar ibn Sa'id, who was known as Muhaimin (the Trustworthy), to be his governor over Alexandria.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Tarikh Dimashq (The History of Damascus) by Ibn Asakir - Volume 1, page 274 The name Muhaimin carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Muhaimin ibn Sa'd Al-Ashja'i was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. He was known for his honesty and trustworthiness. In the early Islamic period, he was appointed as the governor of Alexandria by 'Amr ibn Al-'As and later played a significant role in establishing the Islamic rule in Egypt.

modern_usage.modern_context: Muhaimin is a name of Arabic origin, meaning 'protector' or 'guardian'. It is a name commonly used in the Islamic world, particularly in the Middle East. In modern contexts, the name Muhaimin is seen on various platforms. On social media, it is used as a personal name for individuals. In online communities, it is used as a term of respect for community leaders or protectors. On genealogy websites, it is used as a surname or family name for individuals with Arabic heritage. The general trends show that the name Muhaimin continues to be popular in the Islamic world and is used as a meaningful and significant name for individuals and families.
